summary.text: Camille Pattison is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A community development professional with more than 25 years in local and regional government, Pattison lists public education funding, housing and childcare, and transportation as priorities.

paragraphs.text: Pattison earned a high school diploma from Chelmsford High School and a bachelor's degree from Western Washington University in 1998.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Pattison said her degree was a BA in Environmental Studies with a focus in land use planning.

She said she has spent over 25 years in local and regional government roles in transportation and land use planning, including as a Community Development Director, an Assistant Director at a regional planning commission, and Transit Administrator for the City of Nashua, NH Transit System.
Pattison advanced from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary alongside incumbent Linda Ryan and Renae Lias.

In the survey, Pattison named three campaign messages: investing in public education, including increased state funding and protecting public dollars from being diverted to private accounts; supporting families through housing and childcare; and prioritizing transportation for all.
She listed AFT-NH as an endorser.
